name: The Gardens Hotel - St. Giles Mid Valley Kuala Lumpur
detail: The rooms in this hotel are spacious and comfortable. The bathroom is fully equipped, making one feel very relaxed. The transportation is convenient, not only near major attractions, but also with convenient airport transfers, providing an excellent walking experience. The cleanliness of the hotel and the service from the staff are impressive. It is well-equipped, offers great value for money, and overall provides a pleasant stay experience. Highly recommended!
area: Mid Valley / Bangsar,Kuala Lumpur - View on map

name: Palette KL Sentral near Pudu LRT formerly RPC Blissful Homes
detail: The location is convenient, about a 10-minute walk from the LRT station. The room is a bit small, but if you consider it just a place to sleep, the atmosphere isn't bad. Points of concern include the lack of a refrigerator in the room, the weak water pressure in the shower, and some slight noise leakage from the neighboring room. On the other hand, the free Wi-Fi was reliable and had decent speed, so researching on my smartphone was comfortable. Additionally, the staff was very kind and reassuring, and the deposit I left at check-in was smoothly returned at check-out. There are some downsides, but personally, I didn’t feel any major inconveniences. If you're someone who wants to keep accommodation costs low while traveling, I think this hotel is definitely a good option.

name: Palette KL Sentral Station Formerly Scott Hotel
detail: Bilik bersih,mudah utk makan,staff baik,cuma sabun n shampoo kena request,bantal tidur saya suka empok,tv sahaja channel terok perlu d perbaiki,yg paling best ada tanda kiblat cuma tak ada sejadah,ada mini fridge,hair dryer,iron mudah dan bebaloi utk bilik budget 🌹

name: M World Hotel
detail: The variety of food selection for breakfast & lunch is superb. Accommodations and facilities are up to date.
area: One Utama / Damansara,Kuala Lumpur - View on map

name: Sleeping Lion Suites
detail: The facility was clean, the rooms were clean and properly cleaned every day. It's close to the pavilion, and there are many restaurants nearby, so I think it's safe even if you return late at night. I returned on a late-night flight, but they kept my luggage after checkout. I used a double bed room alone, but it might be cramped if it were for two people. Check-in takes some time, so let's be patient while waiting. ^^
area: Bukit Bintang,Kuala Lumpur - View on map

name: Holiday Inn Express Kuala Lumpur City Centre By IHG
detail: My stay at Holiday Inn Express Kuala Lumpur City Centre was absolutely flawless. The location is incredibly strategic right in the heart of the city, placing Bukit Bintang, KLCC, and the Raja Chulan Monorail station just a short walk away. The room was exceptionally clean, modern, and comfortable, featuring plush bedding and great soundproofing for a restful night's sleep. The staff provided warm, efficient, and professional service throughout check-in and check-out, with the added bonus of a delicious complimentary breakfast. Overall, it offers fantastic value and an outstanding experience for both business and leisure travel. I would definitely return!
area: Kuala Lumpur City Centre,Kuala Lumpur - View on map

name: DoubleTree by Hilton Kuala Lumpur
detail: We stayed in a twin executive room as a family of three. We arrived in Malaysia on a night flight from Thailand, so we checked in at the hotel close to 12:30 AM. We were greeted with warm welcome cookies and taken to our room. They quickly brought in a rollaway bed. I thought they could have prepared it beforehand, but the staff was very friendly and brought extra amenities for one person. The hotel is located inside Intermark, which was very easy to find and using Grab was convenient. Shopping at the supermarket was very convenient. We purchased a lot of snacks for souvenirs. We also used the lounge, which had a quiet and calming atmosphere. The breakfast buffet was truly varied, and we were full every day. I wanted to swim in the pool, but since we were out sightseeing during the day… and I thought about doing it in the morning, but it didn’t seem sunny in the morning and looked cold, so I decided against it. My husband and son used the gym every day and were very satisfied. It’s a hotel we would like to use again.
area: Kuala Lumpur City Centre,Kuala Lumpur - View on map

name: Hilton Kuala Lumpur
detail: The atmosphere of the room, the view, the luxurious bathtub, and the plenty of hot water were all perfect. The breakfast was also delicious and had a variety of options. The staff's service was wonderful, making for a comfortable stay! I would like to stay again if the opportunity arises; it is a great hotel!
area: Kuala Lumpur Sentral,Kuala Lumpur - View on map

name: Armani Residence and Hotel Kuala Lumpur
detail: I stayed for a total of two nights. It was quite rushed and I had things to do, so I didn't go to the pool area and can't comment on that. However, the room facilities were nice, with all the necessary furniture and appliances, and it was quite clean. I stayed alone, so it was more than enough, but it might be a bit cramped for a family, so it's better to book a larger room. The floor-to-ceiling window offers a view of the Petronas Towers at night, although it's a bit far away. The room was nice, but the hallway leading to the room was a bit empty and poorly decorated, which felt a bit unsettling. The building is quite tall, but there are only three elevators, so the wait time is a bit long. If you're going to the Petronas Towers, walking might take some time, so I recommend taking a taxi since you have to walk along a major road with heavy traffic. Overall, I was satisfied.
area: Kuala Lumpur City Centre,Kuala Lumpur - View on map

name: Moxy Kuala Lumpur Chinatown
detail: It's very convenient to go anywhere, and taking a taxi is easy. After waking up, you can walk to eat at Xin Jiu Ru Xin Ji Beef Noodle. Our flight arrived in the middle of the night, and after taking a taxi to the hotel it was almost two o'clock. Surprisingly, there were still three staff members working at the reception, and we even managed to buy food and fruit. The room is very clean, the view from the higher floors is excellent, and the cost-performance ratio is very high. There is a laundry room on the 8th floor, and you can buy laundry coins at the reception, which is really friendly for the sweaty weather every day.
